name: Paddle (Paddle Billing)

webhook.algorithm: Header `Paddle-Signature` with value `ts=<unix_seconds>;h1=<hex>`. HMAC-SHA256 over the string `<ts>:<raw_request_body>` (colon separator), keyed with the notification-destination secret. TIMESTAMP IS SIGNED — official SDK helpers enforce a 5-second tolerance by default; docs note 5–30 seconds is appropriate. Header may carry multiple `h1` values during secret rotation. Body must not be re-serialized. Verified.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Webhook/notification secret prefix `pdl_ntfset_` VERIFIED (example in docs: pdl_ntfset_01gkpjp8bkm3tm53kdgkx6sms7_...). API key prefixes `pdl_live_apikey_` / `pdl_sdbx_apikey_` are reported but NOT verified this pass — mark UNKNOWN in provi

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — not verified this pass. The commonly cited figure is 5% + $0.50 per transaction, but Paddle's published rate card was not confirmed in this research pass; do not ship a number until re-verified.

notes: The merchant-of-record default for EU/UK B2B SaaS. It removes EU VAT OSS registration, per-country VAT rates, reverse-charge/VIES B2B validation and invoicing from generated code entirely — that is a large block of code PagoKit otherwise has to emit and keep correct. Lemon Squeezy (shipped) is an MoR too but is positioned at small digital-goods sellers; Paddle is what EU SaaS with B2B invoicing actually uses.

SDKs: Official SDKs: node (@paddle/paddle-node-sdk), python (paddle-python-sdk), php (paddlehq/paddle-php-sdk), plus a JS checkout SDK (@paddle/paddle-js). Each has a webhook verifier that enforces the timestamp tolerance — use it rather than hand-rolling.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps lemonsqueezy (both MoR). Differentiator: B2B invoicing, VAT-number validation, and EU SaaS subscription tooling.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
